audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers said Skill for levels 1 through 4-5, Locke at level 6 and first item, and Skill at 2+ items — while every whys[] line says Fiora owns 1 through 4-5, 6 and first item are even, and 2+ items is hers. The packet chart matches the prose.
audit.why: Fiora walks a 950-range marker down with Q Lunge and Vitals from level 1; Purgatory makes 6 and first item even, not won; and her Grand Challenge sustain takes the late rows back.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 to Fiora, rows 4-5 to Skill, row 6 to Fiora, in BOTH layers, ratings 4/4/4/4/5/5/3, and the two Locke-arguing why lines rewritten. TRICKY 7/10 kept — 48.37% over 674 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page says 'commit while Riposte is down' and never gives its cooldown, so the reader cannot count it.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s against Ashen Pursuit's flat 10s — you get roughly two step-ups per parry early, which is the whole reason the lane is playable. Q Lunge is 13s at rank 1 falling to 6s, and Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: 24s stated in early and spikes[0]; the 13s Lunge in early; the 110s R in spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Purgatory's grounding — the one interaction that decides the fight — appears nowhere. Fiora's passive was called true damage. 'E's takedown reset' was invented. Locke's Q was called Ritual Nails.
audit.why: Riot's passive text says hitting a Vital restores health and grants Move Speed; the trueDamage flag sits on her R, not her passive. Ashen Pursuit is flat 10s with no reset in the file. Purgatory grounds, and a grounded Fiora has no Lunge — she has to walk, which is exactly the pattern this lane needs.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated as the answer to Lunge in mid and late; the Vital heal restated as healing (Grievous Wounds live); the false E reset removed; Soul Nails used.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte only stuns if it parried an IMMOBILISING effect — the page implies it always stuns.
audit.why: It changes what you may safely throw into the parry window: damage gets eaten, but it does not upgrade her counter unless the thing she blocked was immobilising.

edits.before: Purgatory online: top lane's long brawls now end at YOUR floor. Anyone who all-ins you under a third is volunteering for the totem.
edits.after: Purgatory grounds her: no Lunge, she has to walk. That evens the duel, but Grand Challenge still heals her back over your floor if you ult early.

edits.before: Lich Bane spike — the blink-consume chunk finally out-numbers their sustain. Cash kill windows before their second item re-rigs the math.
edits.after: Lich Bane makes the bite real, but a held Riposte eats it. Even — bait the 16-24s parry, then blink, and buy Grievous Wounds for her Vitals.

edits.before: Fiora dominates this band — her Q Lunge and E Bladework let her walk up, proc Vitals, and W Riposte your Q Ritual Nails or any commit while her passive true-damage shreds you.
edits.after: Fiora dominates this band — Q Lunge and E Bladework walk her up onto Vitals that heal her, and W Riposte, 24s at rank 1, eats your Q Soul Nails or any commit you lead with.

edits.before: Level 6 evens: your R Purgatory execute totem gives you a real all-in answer to her sustain, but her Grand Challenge Vitals heal can pull her back above your threshold if you mistime it.
edits.after: Level 6 evens: R Purgatory grounds Lunge and sets a floor under the duel, but Grand Challenge heals her off every Vital she lands, so a mistimed ult just gets healed through.

edits.before: Roughly even into first item as your AP R and W burst can convert a caught Fiora, but she can still W Riposte your key ability to negate the kill.
edits.after: Even into first item — your burst converts a caught Fiora, but Riposte eats whatever you lead with, and it only upgrades to a stun if what it blocked was immobilising.

edits.before: Late game returns to Fiora — her R Grand Challenge sustain and W Riposte stun on your engage let her outlast and flip your all-in, especially if she dodges your R timing.
edits.after: Late game returns to Fiora — a 110s Grand Challenge heals her and her team off four Vitals, and a held Riposte flips your all-in the moment you lead with anything.

edits.before: Levels 1-4 belong to Fiora. She walks up with Q Lunge, procs her passive Vitals for true damage, and holds W Riposte to parry and stun whatever you commit — including your Q Ritual Nails cast or your W Soul Ignition all-in. Farm carefully, keep your E Ashen Pursuit up as an escape, and never blow a key ability while her Riposte is available.
edits.after: Levels 1-4 belong to Fiora. She walks up with a 13s Q Lunge, procs Vitals that heal her, and holds W Riposte to parry whatever you commit — your Q Soul Nails cast or your W Soul Ignition all-in. Farm carefully, keep E Ashen Pursuit as an escape, and spend nothing while a 24s Riposte is available.

edits.before: Level 6 is your even window. R Purgatory finally gives you an execute answer to her sustain and duel pressure. But her R Grand Challenge heals off proccing Vitals, so if you ult too early she heals back above your threshold — burst her down with W and P missing-HP procs first, then drop the totem, and only after her W Riposte is spent.
edits.after: Level 6 is your even window. R Purgatory grounds her — no Lunge in or out, so she has to walk the duel. Her R Grand Challenge still heals off every Vital, so if you ult early she climbs back over your floor: burn her with W and your missing-HP on-hits first, drop Purgatory second, and only once Riposte is spent.

edits.before: Late game swings back to Fiora. Grand Challenge sustain plus a well-held W Riposte on your engage lets her parry your burst and outlast your R threshold. Your first-item burst can still convert a caught Fiora, but if she reads your R timing or parries your commit she flips the duel. Pick isolated angles and use E's takedown reset to disengage when the parry is up.
edits.after: Late game swings back to Fiora. Grand Challenge plus a well-held Riposte parries your burst and outlasts your threshold. Purgatory's grounding is still your one edge — a grounded Fiora cannot Lunge onto a Vital or out of your zone. Pick isolated angles and keep the flat 10s E for the moment her parry is up.

edits.before: Proc Vitals with Q Lunge and E Bladework
edits.after: Proc Vitals with Q Lunge to heal off you

notes: Purgatory's grounding against Q Lunge is the decisive interaction and it was absent from all thirty-plus writable fields on this page — it now appears in phases[4].why, spikes[1], mid and late. Two things flagged by the mirror and left alone: wants.you[0..2] and wants.foe[1..2] are all short strings the applier skips, and several read as filler ('Reach 6 so R Purgatory answers her sustain') — they want a manual pass. Whether grounding blocks Lunge specifically is inferred from the dash flag on that ability, not from Riot's text.
